# NeelaOS: full description

Website: {{site.url}}
Download: {{dl.href}}

Creator and owner: {{author.name}}
Last updated: {{today}}

NeelaOS is a free, Windows-familiar Linux desktop for Computer Science students, with every coding tool ready from the very first boot. It is a Fedora Remix: Fedora's packages and security updates, with NeelaOS's own look, apps, setup and defaults on top. Base: {{release.base}}. Desktop: {{release.desktop}}. Tagline: "{{site.tagline}}". "Neela" means blue.

## Why NeelaOS

Most students learn to code on Windows, then spend their first weeks fighting setup: installers, PATH variables, MinGW, WSL and broken compilers. NeelaOS pairs a familiar Windows-like desktop with every development tool already installed, so a student can install it and start learning to code the same day.

## Feels like Windows

- Taskbar with a Start button (the NeelaOS logo), pinned apps, system tray and clock
- Desktop icons, double-click to open, minimize/maximize/close on the right, white cursor
- Files app laid out like File Explorer: menu bar, navigation buttons, address bar, search, sidebar with Quick access, Network and This PC, thumbnails, zip support, "Open Terminal Here"
- Plain-named apps: Files, Terminal, Settings, Task Manager, Snipping Tool, Photos, Notepad, Calculator, NeelaPDF, NeelaZip, NeelaConnect, NeelaDiary, Neela PC, Neela Store

### Keyboard shortcuts

{{/each}}
## Ready to code on day one

- Languages: C/C++ (gcc, g++, gdb, Valgrind, CMake, make), Python 3 + pip, Java (OpenJDK), Node.js + npm, SQLite
- Editor: VS Code with C/C++, Python, Java, Jupyter, web, formatter, theme and icon extensions, installed on first boot
- Git plus rgit ({{links.rgit}}): rgit push "message", rgit pull, rgit status, rgit undo
- Ubuntu-style package management: sudo apt install / update / upgrade / remove / search, including Ubuntu package names like build-essential
- Containers: Podman with Docker command compatibility
- Terminal: Git-aware prompt, tldr, ready-made templates (C, C++, Python, Java, HTML, Markdown) via right-click "Create New"
- Dev packs (one click in the Welcome app): {{#each devPacks}}{{this}}; {{/each}}

## Everyday apps

Brave (default browser, NeelaOS start page), Thunderbird, LibreOffice with an Office-style ribbon saving .docx/.xlsx/.pptx by default, fonts matching Calibri, Cambria, Arial, Times New Roman and Courier New, Music, Videos, Photos, Camera, Paint, Scanner, NeelaConnect (phone link), HP printer drivers.

## Safe and easy to maintain

- Restore points before every update and once a day; roll back with the Restore Points app, personal files are kept
- NVIDIA drivers set up automatically
- Secure Boot works out of the box (Fedora's signed boot chain)
- Updates for Fedora, NeelaOS, Brave and VS Code in one place: Neela Store → Updates, or `sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade`

## Look

Neela Dark and Neela Light themes, six original wallpapers ({{#each wallpapers}}{{name}}{{#if default}} (default){{/if}}, {{/each}}), custom boot menu, splash, login screen, the Neela Setup installer and the "Digital Dawn" startup sound. Colours: navy #222B56, blue #0B4683, teal #1A9695, gold #D69510, light gold #F2D678.

Try it in VirtualBox: New VM, Type Linux, Version Fedora (64-bit), enable EFI, 4-6 GB memory, 2-4 CPUs, 40 GB disk, VMSVGA display with 128 MB.

## Good to know

- Windows-only apps (Microsoft Office desktop, Adobe, anti-cheat games) don't run. Use LibreOffice or Office online; many games work through Steam's Proton; the Run Windows Programs pack handles simple .exe files.
- Ubuntu .deb files can't be installed. Use Neela Store (Flatpak) or the app's .rpm version.
- Brave installs on first boot, so the live USB has no visible browser.
- In the Terminal, copy/paste are Ctrl+Shift+C / Ctrl+Shift+V.
